en.name: GroceryMatch: Save on Food
en.title: GroceryMatch — Save on Food
en.subtitle: Compare grocery & meal prices
en.short_description: Compare your grocery list across stores, and meal prices across delivery apps.
en.description:
GroceryMatch takes your shopping list and tells you which store fills it for least — and, when it is worth the extra stop, how to split it across two.

—— Groceries ——

BEST BASKET
Enter a list and compare the whole basket across Walmart, Kroger, Target, Publix, Albertsons and Aldi. Not item-by-item guessing: the total for the list you actually wrote.

SPLIT TRIP
When one store is cheaper for produce and another for staples, GroceryMatch works out whether the saving justifies the second stop.

COUPON STACKING
Finds coupons that combine, rather than showing you one and stopping.

RECEIPT AND BARCODE SCAN
Scan a receipt to build a list from what you already buy, or a barcode to price a single item.

MEAL PLANNER AND PANTRY
Plan meals, track what is already in the cupboard, and keep the list honest.

PRICE HISTORY
See whether an item's price is genuinely low this week.

—— Dining ——

The same idea applied to eating out. Compare a meal across DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub and pickup, with a breakdown of the menu markup each app adds, suggested combo swaps, and current restaurant deals.

—— No account needed ——

Tap "Continue as Guest" and everything works. Sign in only if you want your lists on more than one device.

—— About prices ——

Prices vary by store and region and change constantly. GroceryMatch shows what it last saw; confirm at the register or at checkout.

en.release_notes:
GroceryMatch 2.1.

• Best Basket compares your whole list across six grocery chains
• Split Trip tells you when a second stop is actually worth it
• Coupon stacking finds coupons that combine
• Receipt and barcode scanning
• Meal planner, pantry tracking and price history
• Dining: compare a meal across DoorDash, UberEats, Grubhub and pickup, with menu-markup breakdown
• Works as a guest; sign-in only syncs lists across devices

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
GroceryMatch takes your shopping list and tells you which store fills it for least — and, when it is worth the extra stop, how to split it across two.

Intended audience:
Compare grocery & meal prices

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
The app opens on a sign-in screen. An account is optional; the main features can be reached without signing in.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Firebase (Google) — app initialisation
- Firebase Authentication (Google) — sign-in
- Supabase — account and data storage
- Google Sign-In — authentication
- Sign in with Apple — authentication
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
Account deletion is available in the app under Settings, and on the support site.
